registry.purpose: Govern source identity, versions, corrections, structured clinical-content packages, EFW formula packages, fetal-size reference packages, longitudinal velocity-model packages, module dependencies and production eligibility for ODRISC Interactive Lookup Assistant Master v3.
registry.source_production_rule: registry_status=registered AND clinical_review_status=clinically_verified AND adoption_status in [approved_for_lookup, approved_with_restrictions] AND retrieval_status in [enabled, restricted]
registry.content_production_rule: content_package_status in [release_ready, restricted_release] AND every displayed clinical statement resolves to a reviewed content_id and source_id
registry.combined_production_rule: All applicable source, content-package and numerical-method gates must pass. Registry presence, an official URL, a publication or a working calculator is never sufficient by itself for authoritative production retrieval or numerical activation.
registry.numerical_method_production_rule: For an executable formula/reference/model, method_package.applicable=true AND method_package.package_status in [utility_release_ready, restricted_release] AND exact package identity, supported domain, formula/transformation contract, units, interpolation/tail policy where applicable, integrity record, numerical test version and independent benchmark/review evidence are recorded.

longitudinal_growth_family.principle: Fetal-size position and interval-growth/velocity are linked but statistically distinct products.

growth_velocity_analysis.non_equivalence_rule: Size-reference curves and longitudinal velocity distributions are separate statistical objects. A median-size-curve interval comparison is descriptive and must not be labelled a velocity percentile.

promotion_architecture.principle: Clinical source lookup and patient-specific numerical execution are independent release tracks. A source may be production-enabled for reviewed evidence lookup while its numerical method remains disabled.

lookup_track.release_ready_rule: All required lookup gates are passed or explicitly waived by an authorized reviewer; release scope/restrictions are recorded; release_approval is passed.
lookup_track.enable_rule: lookup_release_ready plus deployment/feature enablement. Enabling lookup does not enable any patient-specific numerical method.

numerical_track.release_ready_rule: All applicable numerical gates are passed or explicitly waived under controlled change approval; exact method/package identity is locked; release_approval is passed.
numerical_track.enable_rule: utility_release_ready plus deployment/feature enablement. lookup_enabled is not sufficient to enable numerical output.

rollback_policy.lookup: A material correction, unresolved licensing issue, failed QA, source integrity concern or clinically material update may move an enabled source to restricted_lookup or suspended without deleting history.
rollback_policy.numerical: A coefficient/code/package change, failed benchmark, domain defect, unit defect, integrity failure or clinical-method concern may move utility_enabled to restricted_utility or suspended.
rollback_policy.historical_rule: Historical signed reviews remain reconstructable with the source/method version active at the time.

wave_1_launch_core_lookup.purpose: Review and release the core source evidence required for the launch Lookup Assistant. This queue does not enable numerical calculation.

wave_2_module_support_lookup.purpose: Promote supporting dating, maternal-weight, reference-policy, measurement-reference and methodology sources.

wave_3_methodology_lookup.purpose: Enable clinician-facing method/reference documentation where appropriate while keeping patient-specific numerical execution disabled.

wave_4_numerical_method_enablement.purpose: Independently validate and release numerical formulas/reference adapters/model implementations one by one.

research_watch.purpose: Govern research-watch sources separately from production clinical guidance.

promotion_summary.note: No source is automatically promoted by this schema migration. Version 3.1 creates the release machinery and queues; actual approval requires recorded gate evidence.
